item.title: Gulls Hunt for Win Over Firebirds
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls are set to take on the Coachella Valley Firebirds tonight at Acrisure Arena (7 p.m. PST; TV: AHLTV on FloHockey; Radio: Gulls Audio Network). The contest tonight will be the seventh time the teams have met this season and will close out the road portion of the season series. The pair will only meet one more time after tonight for San Diego’s final matchup of the regular season. The Gulls are currently 1-3-2-0 against the Firebirds this season

item.title: Sidorov's Heroics Give San Diego 4-3 Victory Over Coachella Valley
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls defeated the Coachella Valley Firebirds tonight for the first time since their season-opener at Acrisure Arena, 4-3. Yegor Sidorov had himself a night as he recorded his second three-point game of the season. item.title: Gulls Take Third Straight with Win Over Silver Knights
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls extended their win streak to three as they defeated the Henderson Silver Knights tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 7-4. The seven goals scored ties San Diego’s scoring record this season, becoming the second time the team has found the back of the net that many times. item.title: Calle Clang Named To 2026 AHL All-Star Classic Presented By BMO
item.description: The American Hockey League (AHL) announced today that goaltender Calle Clang has been named to the 2026 AHL All-Star Classic presented by BMO, to be held February 10-11 in Rockford, Ill. Clang, 23 (5/20/02), joins forward Tim Washe at the 2026 All-Star Classic, the fourth time in franchise history the Gulls have had two All-Star representatives and the first since 2020 (Chris Wideman and Anthony Stolarz, Ontario). item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com Calle Clang is turning more and more heads while protecting the crease for the San Diego Gulls this season.
